filesystem.description: Access pipeline configurations, ETL scripts, data quality rules, and orchestration DAGs

github.description: Version control data pipeline code, review PRs, track schema evolution

postgres.description: Query data warehouse schemas, analyze table statistics, implement data quality checks

data_quality_checks.description: Use Postgres MCP to run validation queries and data quality checks directly on databases
data_quality_checks.example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date IS NULL

schema_documentation.description: Use Filesystem MCP to read/write schema definitions and data dictionaries
schema_documentation.example: Read schema.yml, update with new fields and constraints

pipeline_version_control.description: Use GitHub MCP to manage pipeline code versions and collaborate on changes
pipeline_version_control.example: Review PR for new Airflow DAG, track changes to transformation logic

best_practices_lookup.description: Use Context7 MCP to find data engineering patterns and optimization techniques
best_practices_lookup.example: Search for 'Spark partition optimization' or 'Kafka exactly-once semantics'

configuration_notes.filesystem: Automatically configured with repository root. Use for accessing pipeline code and configs.
configuration_notes.github: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your environment or .env file. Requires repo scope for private repositories.
configuration_notes.postgres: Update connection string format: postgresql://user:password@host:port/database. Supports multiple database connections.
configuration_notes.context7: Set CONTEXT7_API_KEY for documentation search. Sign up at context7.com for API access.
